title: Warp config tabs
description: A 'config as code' section: typed tag, mono title and lead with an outline 'learn more' button at the right, then a framed panel whose top is a full-width row of uppercase tabs (the active one solid brand blue), a muted description, and a hairline figure holding a file list (the open file highlighted blue) beside a numbered code view with brand-blue keys. Phones stack the tabs as a list and show only the code.
notes: tabs switch with React state, so it needs hydrate
each tab may bring its own files and code; tabs without them show the first tab's
the code highlighter colours 'key:' at the start of a line, YAML style
